set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/surface, avoiding active GIFTI reader paths unless coordinated. Acceptance: add a SurfaceDomain or phantom domain path for SurfaceGeometry, MeshTopology, SurfaceField, LabeledSurface, and SurfaceGeometryPair; hide public neighbor row indexing behind neighborsOf; split usable cortical hemispheres from Unknown/Both IO tags; introduce typed ParcelLabel/ParcelPart and SurfaceError/readEither constructors. Verification: surfaceJVM/test and surfaceJS/test; coordinate with active GIFTI mote before touching reserved gifti/io files.
